rv.q: But its status as a theatrical piece is often overwhelmed by the sheer volume of information that pushes this towards counter-journalism.

Three years into this there is a sense amongst many in support of the Palestinian people that violent state power, across many states, is being used to curb the support of the general public. The cost of Western comfort is once again being challenged, and the new play by Béznă theatre sits exactly in this discomfort.

On one of the side walls, a running total charts the number of Palestinians martyred, with the number of journalists martyred on another. One of the major issues with this element of the production, however, is how quickly the dates and their corresponding captions roll along across the 90-minute runtime.

For me, this is where The First Year (of the Gaza Genocide in the Media) falls short. The production, developed by BÉZNĂ Theatre with the International State Crime Initiative and Shadow World Investigations, is an ambitious collaboration built from testimony and research.
